questions.question: Discuss the significance of Quality Assurance. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Responsible for ensuring that the quality policies adopted by a company are followed. It
  • helps to identify and prepare the necessary SOPs related to the control of quality. It must
  • determine that the product meets all the applicable specifications and that it wa s
  • manufactured according to the internal standards of GMP . QA also holds responsibility for
  • quality monitoring or audit function. QA functions to assess operations continually and to
  • advise and guide them towards full compliance with all applicable internal and external
  • regulations.

questions.question: Explain the role of scidity in food processing. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• The acidity of food is its concentration of hydrogen ions measured on the pH scale, where
  • a lower pH indicates higher acidity. Acidity plays a crucial role in food processing by acting
  • as a preservative, enhancing flavor, improving texture, and maintaining consistency.
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Define size. Explain its importance in food processing with suitable examples. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Size is an important attribute of foods used for screening solids to separate foreign materials
  • & grading of fruits & v egetables. In fluid flow , heat & mass transfer calculations, it is
  • necessary to know the size of the sample.
  • Example: Smaller particles may impact pu mping. & mixing process (as the particles
  • becomes more vi scous) In the case of large particles , may occur sedimentation/separation.
  • Size of the particulate food is also critical.
  • Particle size of powdered milk must be large enough to prevent agglomeration but small
  • enough to allow rapid dissolution during reconstitution.
  • Particle sizes are expressed in different units coarse particles measured in (mm), fine
  • particles are measured in terms of screen/ mesh size, very fine particles in (nm)
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Describe how sulphur dioxide acts as a preservative. / [CO3] [5x4 = 20]
questions.solution_html:
• Sulphur dioxide has been used in foods for long and as a general preservative. It is used in
  • the treatment of fruits and vegetables before and after dehydration to extend the storage life,
  • prevent the growth of undesirable microorganisms and in making of fr uit juices. It is also
  • the most useful agent for the preservation of brow ning reaction s is dried fruits. Most cut
  • fruits are treated with sulphur dioxide to prevent enzymatic browning
